mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS refund_id, r.payment_id, p.pg_transaction_id, r.request_amount, r.idempotency_key, r.status FROM refund r JOIN payment p ON p.id = r.payment_id WHERE r.pg_cancel_confirmed = false AND r.status IN ('PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED') AND r.requested_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(6), INTERVAL #{thresholdMinutes} MINUTE) AND r.id > #{lastId} AND r.is_deleted = false ORDER BY r.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE refund SET status = 'COMPLETED', processed_at = NOW(6), updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{refundId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_cancel (payment_id, refund_id, cancel_amount, reason, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{paymentId}, #{refundId}, #{cancelAmount}, #{reason}, NOW(6), NOW(6), NOW(6), false)
mapper.update: UPDATE refund SET pg_cancel_confirmed = true, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{refundId} AND pg_cancel_confirmed = false
